Errata and Rulings are available from WotC's web page (see link in .sig)

The references to rules look like [#.#.#] and refer to section in the
revised rulebook (see link in .sig).

The references to Rules Team Rulings look like [RTR DD-MON-YY] and refer
to posts made by the Rules Team (formerly known as the Design Team) to
this group. If you require the actual text of an entry in one of these
posts, I'd be happy to post it. If you require the full text of one (or
all, if you've got excess disk space) of these posts, e-mail me and
I'll mail you a copy.

Other references tend to refer to Net.Rep statements that were made
outside of the context of the Rules Team. These are cited as [INI DD-MON-YY]
Where INI can be one of:

LSJ - L. Scott Johnson (me), the current Net.Rep and Rules Authority.
JON - John Wilkie aka Scalpel, the previous Net.Rep.
SFC - Shawn F. Carnes, the previous Net.Rep.
TOM - Thomas R. Wylie, the original Net.Rep.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com) VTES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
Links to revised rulebook, rulings, errata, and DCI (tournament) rules:
http://www.wizards.com/VTES/VTES_Rules.html
